startScreen.title: We're Not Really Strangers 2
description: No small talk here, just genuine collisions.
From "who you think I am" to "who you actually are."
Stay honest, stay brave, or... stay silent.

endScreen.title: Journey Complete
endScreen.subtitle: You've shared more than just words
